visualSpecExcerpt:
=== SIGN IN PAGE SPEC (viewport 390x844, iOS) ===
[LAYOUT]
status-bar: top 0, height 54px (9:41 + icons), Dynamic Island pill center
container: white bg, padding 24px, flex column, items center
paw-logo: top, margin-top 24px, paw svg 36px (#C2185B or dark)
signin-header: 'Sign in' 28px 700 #C2185B, margin-top 16px, text-center
google-btn: full width, height 52px, border-radius 26px, bg #C2185B, color #FFFFFF, flex row centered, 'G' svg 20px + 'With Google' 15px 600, margin-top 32px
social-row: flex row centered, gap 16px, margin-top 16px; two circular buttons 56x56, border 1px #E0E0E0, radius 50%, bg #FFFFFF, centered 'f' (Facebook #1877F2) and bird (Twitter #1DA1F2) svg 24px
divider: flex row items center, margin-top 28px; line 1px #E0E0E0 flex 1, 'Or with Email' 12px #9E9E9E padding 0 12px, line 1px #E0E0E0 flex 1
email-input: width 100%, height 52px, border-radius 16px, border 1px #E0E0E0, padding 0 16px, flex row, leading mail svg 20px #9E9E9E, input flex 1 (placeholder 'Email'), trailing green check svg 20px #4CAF50, margin-top 24px
password-input: same shape, leading lock svg 20px, input type password value '••••••••', trailing 'Forgot?' 12px 600 #C2185B, margin-top 16px
cta: 'Get Started' full width, height 56px, border-radius 30px, bg #C2185B, color #FFFFFF, 16px 600, margin-top 28px, box-shadow 0 8px 20px rgba(194,24,91,0.25)
footer: 'New User? Sign Up' 14px center, margin-top 20px; 'New User? ' #9E9E9E + 'Sign Up' #C2185B 600
[COLORS]
primary: #C2185B
border: #E0E0E0
muted: #9E9E9E
success: #4CAF50
facebook: #1877F2
twitter: #1DA1F2
[RADII]
cta-pill: 30px
google-pill: 26px
input: 16px
social-circle: 50%
=== END SPEC ===
contentToPreserve: Google button: 'With Google' (magenta pill, white G icon)
Email input with green checkmark validation
Password input with masked dots + 'Forgot?' link
Footer: 'New User? Sign Up' ('Sign Up' magenta link)

pageSpecificSpec: Sign in screen. White centered column. Paw logo top. 'Sign in' header (28px bold magenta). 'With Google' full-width magenta pill (white G icon). Two circular outlined Facebook/Twitter buttons (56px). 'Or with Email' divider. Email input (52px, 16px radius, mail icon + green check). Password input (lock icon, masked dots, 'Forgot?' magenta link). 'Get Started' full-width magenta CTA (56px, 30px radius). Footer 'New User? Sign Up' with magenta 'Sign Up' link.
